open_items: ILO: periodic 403 pattern, fifth cleared occurrence. Last 403 was cycle 1366 (2026-11-16 00:01Z, gateway-only); cycles 1367-1369 all healthy, about 6.5 hours clean as of this run (06:44Z). Live recheck at 06:44Z got a clean 200 direct in 3.2s. The shrinking-interval trend flagged last run has not continued further; keep watching, no code action, no evidence of an application bug (shape stays a clean provider-side 403, not the empty-error signature).

ESTAT: gateway_issue at cycle 1369 (newest cycle), 'tool call list_dataflows timed out after 60.0s'. Live recheck: direct full dataflow listing succeeded, HTTP 200 in 31.7s for ~38MB, well under the 60s gateway deadline on its own, so this is the catalogued 'list_dataflows times out under load, works as designed' pattern, not new. Watch cycle 1370; more than one consecutive gateway_issue cycle would be new.

IMF: single-cycle flap at cycle 1368, healthy again by 1369 (resolved before this run looked at it). Failure was the chronic empty-'Error:' gateway bug (tools/sdmx_tools.py bare except Exception) plus a 'Network or transport error' on the data check. This is the first time the empty-error bug has been seen on IMF; previously only ABS, ESTAT and ECB. Live recheck at 06:44Z: IMF direct answers 200 in under 1s, clearly healthy now. Not fixed by this routine.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1369. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 161 as of this run (161 last run), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug noted previously: /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts. Not re-verified this run.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py around lines 207-209 catching Exception with an empty str(e)): previously traced on ABS (many occurrences), ESTAT (cycle 1143, 1335, 1365), and ECB (cycle 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345, 1357). Now also seen on IMF (cycle 1368, self-resolved). It is generic exception-handling code, not endpoint-specific, and has hit 4 of 12 endpoints so far. Not fixed by this routine; it only commits to docs/monitor/.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time across ABS/FBOS/ILO/SBS/OECD (seen again this run on ILO), verdict stays ok as always.
